title: Getting his first banjo and why old instruments sound better
summary: He tried every instrument at home but wanted a banjo; his father's friend got him one for fifty dollars, and he prefers old banjos and calfskin heads.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
